title: Plant Manager
text:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies' core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

 

This role is part of our Space and Launch business, which has contributed to the nation's space programs for decades by delivering complete solutions from concept to flight. We enable successful space operations with mission-critical technology supporting every step from first launch to final landing, including launch vehicle subsystems, propulsion systems, aerodynamic and interstage systems, and payload protection and deployment. Our high-performance solutions are engineered to operate in the most extreme environments and meet precise mission requirements.

As Plant Manager, you will lead site operations and transform business objectives, customer commitments, and production requirements into an integrated operating plan. You will drive cross-functional execution across manufacturing, engineering, maintenance, quality, safety, and support functions while developing organizational capability and delivering measurable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and operational performance.

**Responsibilities**

* Leads Operations, Engineering, Master Scheduling, Facilities and Maintenance, Safety, and Quality, establishing clear priorities, accountability, and ownership across the site.
* Translates revenue plans, customer demand, and business objectives into integrated operating plans aligned with labor, capacity, equipment, materials, technical resources, and infrastructure.
* Drives manufacturing execution to meet production schedules and customer requirements while improving On-Time Delivery (OTD), Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), utilization, productivity, throughput, and cost performance.
* Identifies operational constraints, risks, and resource gaps, and leads cross-functional recovery plans to protect customer commitments and revenue objectives.
* Aligns Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, and Master Scheduling to maintain production-ready processes, tooling, equipment, work instructions, and schedules.
* Leads implementation of engineering changes, new product introductions, process improvements, and capital and facility projects while minimizing disruption to operations.
* Oversees facilities, utilities, and equipment reliability through preventive and predictive maintenance programs, work order management, and performance monitoring.
* Owns site safety and environmental performance, including regulatory compliance, incident investigations, corrective actions, and Injury and Illness Prevention Program (IIPP) execution.
* Leads the Quality function and maintains the effectiveness of the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with AS9100, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Partners with Program Management, Business Development, Finance, and Human Resources to support customer commitments, workforce planning, Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP), leadership development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
* 10+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment with progressive leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience leading multiple manufacturing and operational functions, including Engineering, Facilities, Maintenance, and Quality.
* Proven ability to translate business objectives and revenue targets into operational execution plans.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, master scheduling, capacity management, and manufacturing execution.
* Demonstrated experience managing operational performance metrics, including On-Time Delivery (OTD), Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), utilization, safety, and quality.
* Working knowledge of AS9100 and experience with Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, and root cause analysis methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, build organizational accountability, and make data-driven operational decisions.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, interpersonal, analytical, and business skills.

This position requires U.S. person status under U.S. export control laws, including U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Company‑paid life and AD&D insurance
* Short‑ and long‑term disability coverage
* Tuition reimbursement

Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
